g.text: A transfer that adds load on an import day, inside BSP A

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Import is positive. A transfer that adds load lifts the thick truth line above the thin one by the load added; one that removes load lowers it. The truth also holds the engine and solar output, which lowers it below the base demand line by the generation.'
text.tspan: Import is positive. A transfer that adds load lifts the thick truth line above the thin one by the load added; one that removes load lowers it.
The truth also holds the engine and solar output, which lowers it below the base demand line by the generation.
